desc: Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to W+H+4 modulo 998244353.
Implement nCr(n, r) with safe handling of negative arguments.
Implement S(X, Y) = C(X+Y+4, X+2) - X - Y - 4 mod, returning 0 for X<0 or Y<0.
Implement f_full(W, H) = C(W+H+4, W+2) - W - H - 4 - (W+1)*(H+1) mod.
Compute Sum1 using inclusion-exclusion on S with bounds (L,R) and (D,U).
Compute Sum2 using S with bounds (W-R, W-L) and (H-U, H-D) (adjusting for off-by-one).
Compute the final answer modulo 998244353 and print.
